entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana... I'm calling about an order. I... I need to make a return and I'm just so disappointed about it.
Oh, I'm sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into this for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF88602. It's for a new Aero-Shield helmet. I bought it as a gift.

Okay, I see the order. It looks like it was delivered about 41 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It's a preference, I suppose. It's the color. I got the 'Lunar Gray' and he... well, he just didn't like it. The box is still unopened, we never even took it out. I just feel terrible, and with money being tight, I was really hoping you could help. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years.
I completely understand, and I'm so sorry it wasn't the right fit. Please don't worry. Let me just check the policy for you... one moment.
Okay, yes, good news. Since the helmet is a standard item, it's well within our 90-day return window. We can absolutely process a full refund for you. It's no problem at all.
Oh, really? That's... that's such a relief. Thank you so much, Diana. I was so worried.

Of course. Finding the right gear is what matters most, especially when it comes to safety. I'm also seeing here that you're one of our VIP members, and we truly appreciate your loyalty. I've just emailed you a prepaid return label. As a thank you for your patience, I've also added a 15% discount code to that email for your next purchase.
Wow, that is incredibly kind. You've really turned my day around. Thank you.
You are very welcome. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks again, Diana.
My pleasure. Have a wonderful day, and thank you for being a part of the VeloFit family.
